scope: Local synthetic CPU microbenchmark only; sequential before then after, seven samples per condition plus one warmup. Not end-to-end model latency, dollar savings or population inference. Sparse results include noise/regression. No live calls or benchmark incident data.
change: Compute invalid dependency closure once per synchronous commit, never cache across calls.

raw_before.scope: Local synthetic microbenchmark, not model cost or production latency. Baseline copies identical payloads without metadata and clears all on invalidation; it does not provide equivalent safety/reuse. Commit comparison includes dependency validation and deep copy. Source checks use actual verify_inputs and file fingerprint, but do not validate semantic correctness. Serialization measured before fault injection; JSON byte counts are not memory usage. No persistence/network time included. Construction/setup excluded; raw timing samples retained; no speed threshold asserted.
